==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Youling:''' No, we can't dig a canal in this area or it would disrupt the community structure.
:{{DIcon}} What do you study?
:'''Youling:''' Me? I study biology.
:'''Youling:''' [[Tacetite]] research in the academy is more, after all, [[TD]] rampage, Tacetite weapon is the wind mouth. It's good to set up a project, and there are enough funds for research.
:'''Youling:''' Life is tough for us biologists... I'm just trying to minimize the impact of research and development on the ecosystem.
:'''Youling:''' We have a fragile world now.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah.
:'''Youling:''' That being said, from what I've deduced, there should be giant TDs that mimic normal creatures present in the water system of Gorges of Spirits.
:'''Youling:''' I've never seen a report like this before. It's strange...
{{Dialogue End}}
